title: Growth Tech Lead
motivazione: Il ruolo richiede esperienza consolidata in product management tech, AI e leadership di team di ingegneri; il candidato ha forte background in growth, digital sales e gestione di team, ma manca di esperienza diretta in sviluppo software e AI, che è il requisito principale. Il gap più rilevante è la mancanza di competenze tecniche di ingegneria e AI.
testo_completo: Milan, Italy Hybrid Growth Tech Lead About us Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn’t stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives. By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need. What you’ll be doing As our Growth Tech Lead, you’ll be the person who turns technology, AI and data into Satispay’s next growth engine. You’ll lead a team of growth engineers and growth managers, own the roadmap of what we build, and scale the channels and products that will drive the next chapter of our growth. Referral loops, promotion systems, web apps and AI tools for growth: you’ll own them the way a product owner owns a product. That means defining the problem, prioritising the backlog, running structured experiments and shipping to scale, from first prototype to winning feature. Here’s what your day-to-day will look like: Incubate the next growth features - Turn raw ideas into experiments and minimum viable products (MVPs) that can become new growth features for Satispay or, just as valuable, a clear learning. Be our tech and AI voice in Marketing & Growth - Be the go-to person for how technology and AI can change the way we acquire, activate and retain users. Lead and grow your team - Manage and develop a team of 4 (for now!) made up of AI engineers and growth managers, setting a high bar and creating the space for them to own real problems. Own the roadmap and the sprints - Define priorities, run planning and delivery for the team, and make sure what we ship moves real business metrics. Own and scale referral loops - Take ownership of member-get-member, our referral programme and biggest marketing channel, and design, test and scale referral mechanics for each new Satispay product. Build and ship data products - Take projects from quick AI-built prototype to production, from web apps to growth products that can become part of the Satispay product suite, working closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations and Data. Grow Satispay organically - Own our website and landing pages with one goal: organically growing the Satispay user base. That means search strategy, content and technical performance, and a constant cycle of experimentation and conversion optimisation. Who we’re looking for We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you’re curious and ready for real ownership, you’ll fit in! Does this sound like you? Proven experience - 6+ years of experience in marketing/growth, tech product management and/or software engineering. Technical credibility - You’ve shipped production-grade products and can hold a real conversation with engineers about architecture, trade-offs and quality. Applied AI & automation mindset - You follow what’s happening in AI and know how to turn it into business-ready solutions that solve concrete problems. Growth & referral expertise - You understand funnels, experimentation and conversion optimisation, and ideally you’ve built or scaled referral or viral loops. Product mindset & Project Management - You’re comfortable owning a roadmap, prioritising ruthlessly, and taking ideas from 0→1. Cross-functional influence - You build trust and alignment with Product, Marketing, Sales and Data, even without formal authority. Impact-driven attitude - You’re driven by projects that move real metrics and you’re at ease navigating ambiguity. CareAbout: how we support your impact We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout: ❤️ Health (Private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops) 💰 Financial resources (Stock Option Plan, Meal vouchers, Relocation support if you’re moving countries) ⚙️ Growth and development (Professional development programs, Internal mobility, Language courses with Preply) 🌱 Flexibility (Unlimited PTO, Hybrid working policy*, Flexible working hours) 👨‍👩‍👧 Family (Enhanced parental leave, Additional leave for child sickness) *We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time. Salary: €55.000 - €75.000 gross per annumThis range is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role’s core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value. Equal opportunity employer At Satispay, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs! Learn more about us Our values and pillars aren’t just fancy words on a page - they really shape everything we do. Salary Range: €52,000.00 - €69,333.33 All Compensation Will Be Determined Commensurate With Demonstrated Experience. You’ve built experience, now use it where bold ideas meet real impact. At Opella, we’re challenging how self-care works for millions of people and need leaders and experts ready to shape what’s next. As our Performance Marketing Lead , you’ll bring your eCommerce media expertise, analytical mindset and drive to accelerate growth and make health simpler, smarter and more human. About The Job As Performance Marketing Lead, you will shape and manage our eRetail media strategy for the Italian eCommerce market, with a strong focus on Amazon Advertising. You will drive profitable growth through performance-led media, including on-site paid search, programmatic display and video campaigns tailored to eCommerce platforms. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, National Media, Finance and our in-house eCommerce media buying Centre of Excellence, you will connect local business priorities with our global eCommerce strategy. Your insights will help our brands make better investment decisions, optimise campaign performance and turn eRetail media into a sustainable growth driver. Main Responsibilities Define and implement a cross-platform eRetail media strategy aligned with our eCommerce priorities, including sales growth, profitability, product prioritisation and brand objectives. Lead paid search, programmatic display and video campaigns across eRetail platforms, with a strong focus on Amazon Advertising. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance and National Media teams to align media investment, brand messaging and commercial priorities. Act as the strategic link between the Italian business, global eCommerce teams and our in-house media buying Centre of Excellence. Monitor campaign performance against agreed KPIs, translate results into actionable recommendations and reallocate budgets towards the strongest-performing opportunities. Communicate performance, investment priorities and budget recommendations clearly to brand teams and senior leadership. Build strong partnerships with eRetailers and technology providers, identifying new features, tools and media innovations that can improve performance. Stay ahead of eCommerce, retail media and digital marketing developments to continuously improve our capabilities and ways of working. About You Strong experience managing eRetail media campaigns, particularly within Amazon Advertising and other major eCommerce platforms. A proven track record of using performance marketing to drive online sales, revenue growth and return on media investment. Solid knowledge of paid search, pay-per-click advertising, programmatic display and video within eCommerce ecosystems. Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to interpret campaign and commercial data and turn performance metrics into clear actions. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to influence cross-functional and senior partners. Experience working with media agencies, in-house media buying teams, eRetailers or advertising technology providers. Fluent English and Italian, with the ability to work effectively in an international environment. This is more than the next step in your career, it’s a chance to lead change and help reinvent self-care for the world. If you’re ready to challenge, inspire and deliver impact that matters, we’re ready for you. We are challengers. We are Opella. About Us Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the global Over-the-Counter and Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements market. Our mission is to bring health into people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be for half a billion consumers worldwide, and counting. At the heart of this mission are 100 loved brands, an 11,000-strong global team, 13 manufacturing sites and four specialised science and innovation development centres. Headquartered in France, Opella is the maker of brands including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and a healthier planet. Find out more at www.opella.com. Segnala offerta di lavoro General Manager | Italia | Milano Chi siamo: Fresha Fresha è il sistema operativo basato su intelligenza artificiale leader a livello globale per il settore del beauty e del wellness. Offre alle aziende tutto ciò di cui hanno bisogno per gestire le attività in modo più intelligente, crescere più rapidamente e costruire relazioni più solide con i propri clienti. A maggio 2026, Fresha ha ottenuto un investimento per la crescita di 80 milioni di dollari da KKR con una valutazione di 1 miliardo di dollari, raggiungendo ufficialmente lo status di "unicorno" e portando la raccolta complessiva di capitali a 285 milioni di dollari. Già redditizia, Fresha sta impiegando questo investimento per accelerare l'espansione globale e promuovere la prossima generazione di innovazione di prodotto e IA. Oggi Fresha opera su scala globale, con uffici in Europa, Nord America, Medio Oriente e Asia-Pacifico. La nostra piattaforma gode della fiducia di oltre 130.000 aziende del settore beauty e wellness in 120 Paesi, con oltre 1,5 miliardi di appuntamenti prenotati fino ad oggi. La nostra missione è semplice: aiutare le aziende del settore beauty e wellness a crescere, fornendo loro la tecnologia necessaria per attrarre clienti, gestire le proprie attività e guidare il proprio business da un'unica piattaforma. Continuiamo a crescere rapidamente su mercati, team e prodotti: è un momento entusiasmante per unirsi a noi. Panoramica del ruolo General Manager | Italia | Sede di Milano | In presenza (5 giorni a settimana) Siamo alla ricerca di un General Manager di comprovata esperienza che assuma la piena responsabilità del business di Fresha in Italia, uno dei nostri mercati di espansione più strategici nell'Europa meridionale. Si tratta di un vero e proprio ruolo da GM con piena responsabilità di conto economico (P&L). Guiderai la strategia di mercato per l'Italia, le performance commerciali e l'organizzazione, dirigendo i team locali di Sales e Account Management e collaborando a stretto contatto con Product, Marketing, Operations e Finance per accelerare una crescita esponenziale. Riportando direttamente al CEO, lavorerai a stretto contatto con la leadership globale per definire le priorità strategiche e garantire che le dinamiche uniche e le opportunità del mercato italiano siano adeguatamente rappresentate nelle decisioni aziendali complessive. Dovrai saper operare con pari efficacia a livello strategico ed esecutivo, portando forte acume commerciale, metodo e dinamismo. Costruirai un team di leadership d'eccellenza a Milano, stabilendo una chiara attribuzione di responsabilità e innalzando il livello delle performance in tutta l'organizzazione italiana. Questa è l'opportunità di lanciare, strutturare e guidare un mercato ad alta priorità all'interno di un'azienda tecnologica globale in rapida espansione, con la proprietà diretta della sua traiettoria e un'influenza significativa sulla crescita internazionale di Fresha. Di cosa ti occuperai P&L Italia e performance commerciali: Gestire il P&L dell'Italia, la crescita del fatturato e le performance commerciali complessive, prendendo decisioni su allocazione del capitale, investimenti locali e pianificazione delle risorse per raggiungere obiettivi ambiziosi. Strategia di mercato e localizzazione: Definire la strategia di go-to-market per l'Italia, traducendo la roadmap globale di Fresha in piani operativi nazionali su misura per l'ecosistema locale di saloni, spa e centri benessere. Crescita dei clienti e del fatturato: Supervisionare l'intero funnel commerciale (acquisizione, attivazione, fidelizzazione e monetizzazione), collaborando in modo trasversale tra le funzioni per massimizzare la quota di mercato in Italia. Leadership e organizzazione: Costruire, guidare e far crescere i team italiani di Sales, Business Development e Account Management, promuovendo un elevato senso di responsabilità e una cultura ad alte prestazioni. Collaborazione interfunzionale: Collaborare con i team globali di Product, Marketing, Operations e Finance per localizzare l'offerta di prodotto, rimuovere gli ostacoli alla crescita e rappresentare efficacemente le esigenze del mercato italiano. Rigore operativo ed esecuzione: Istituire routine operative, modelli di previsione e dashboard di monitoraggio, sfruttando i dati commerciali per prendere decisioni rapide e trasformare la strategia in esecuzione concreta. Chi stiamo cercando Esperienza consolidata di General Management: Comprovata esperienza pregressa come General Manager, Country Manager, Managing Director o ruolo dirigenziale commerciale equivalente nella scalabilità di aziende ad alta crescita nei settori tecnologia, SaaS o marketplace in Italia. Non si tratta di una posizione di primo accesso a ruoli di General Management. Responsabilità diretta del P&L: Solida esperienza nella gestione end-to-end di un conto economico, con diretta responsabilità su ricavi, costi, decisioni di investimento e performance aziendali complessive. Scalabilità ed espansione del mercato: Dimostrata capacità di generare una crescita significativa e di far scalare un'organizzazione commerciale o un intero mercato dalle prime fasi fino a posizioni di leadership. Leadership commerciale: Esperienza nella gestione di strutture commerciali complesse e strutturate su più livelli attraverso manager, con una profonda conoscenza dei processi di acquisizione B2B, onboarding degli esercenti e riduzione del tasso di abbandono (churn). Conoscenza del mercato locale e competenze linguistiche: Approfondita comprensione del panorama commerciale, normativo e imprenditoriale italiano. È richiesta la padronanza fluente sia dell'italiano che dell'inglese. Approccio strategico e analitico: Forte rigore analitico e commerciale, con l'abilità di muoversi agilmente tra pianificazione strategica a lungo termine, decisioni basate sui dati ed esecuzione operativa. Gestione degli stakeholder: Capacità comunicative e persuasive di alto livello, idonee a interagire con la C-suite e a collaborare efficacemente all'interno di matrici organizzative internazionali. Le tue opportunità in Fresha Guidare un mercato strategico in crescita: Assumere la piena responsabilità della presenza di Fresha in Italia, uno dei mercati del beauty e wellness più dinamici d'Europa. Gestire il P&L: Responsabilità diretta di ricavi, margini, investimenti e successo operativo in tutto il Paese. Definire il playbook italiano: Determinare la strategia di go-to-market, il posizionamento del brand e la crescita degli esercenti nei principali poli italiani. Creare un team di livello mondiale: Reclutare, scalare e guidare un team commerciale di primo livello basato a Milano. Avere un impatto globale: Rappresentare la voce strategica dell'Italia presso la leadership centrale, orientando gli adattamenti di prodotto e le priorità internazionali. Contribuire a costruire il futuro: Avere un ruolo centrale nella prossima fase di espansione di Fresha mentre continuiamo a scalare la nostra piattaforma, i prodotti e i mercati globali. testo_completo: VP of Marketing VP of Marketing Cleafy Milan, Lombardy, Italy 17 minutes ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who Cleafy has hired for this role Apply Save Report this job Cleafy is a SaaS company, a team of fraud hunters, cybersecurity experts, data scientists and software engineers who, since 2014, have shared the same dream: make technology a safer place. The moment Fraud operations in banking are breaking. Volumes outpace hiring, attackers adopted AI first, and every Tier-1 board wants agentic AI with nothing production-grade to buy. Cleafy built the foundation, and it already runs inside some of Europe's largest banks. We know of no one else who has it. Our Digital Narrative turns raw session telemetry into a typed, causal record of what happened. It runs in production today, for tens of millions of users. On top of it we are building Nyx: autonomous, multi-agent fraud operations in real time, with every decision explainable to a regulator. That is the hard part, and it is why this role exists now rather than after launch. We are looking for the person who closes it. What You Will Own Name and own the category. Define agentic fraud operations for regulated enterprises: the language, the frame, the maturity model. Success is competitors positioning against it and analysts using our vocabulary. With the CEO at first, on your own after two quarters. Move the buyer up two floors. Rebuild the narrative for executives who redesign operating models and own the budget: value case, board framing, the deck a CIO forwards unedited. Make deep tech feel inevitable. Make the Digital Narrative clear to an executive in ninety seconds and rigorous enough for our research team. Storytelling built on the technology, not around it. Own product marketing end to end. Positioning, ICP, messaging, launches, pricing narrative, competitive and enablement. We sell demo-first, so you author the story with the CPO, as a peer. Build the credibility system. Advisory board, analysts on both sides of the Atlantic, press, threat research reporters want, partner co-marketing — so customers conclude we understand the threat better than their own team. Build the team behind you. A small team today and two funded hires to define. Requirements Who you are Bold by default, disciplined by method. You do not study a market in order to fit into it. You study it in order to break it precisely, at scale, and with a plan that survives contact with a Tier-1 procurement process. Detail is not the opposite of ambition here; it is what makes ambition credible. You have: 12+ years in B2B marketing, including time as the senior-most marketing leader in enterprise software or cybersecurity, or as the deputy who ran the function while someone else held the title You have run the whole function, not a slice, and built at least part of the team yourself You have marketed to regulated enterprises: ideally banks in EMEA. Payments, insurance and critical infrastructure count too You write, personally and well, in English. Your application includes one piece that changed what a market believed You use AI every day, not just in your slides. Not someone who "follows the AI topic": someone who has already broken a few workflows to build better ones. You have tried ten tools, thrown out eight, and kept the two that changed how your team works. Before you hire or open a new budget line, you ask: "what if an agent did this?" Even better if: You created a category, or were in the room when one was: a market that did not exist, given a name that stuck. Not a repositioning You can discuss an attack chain with our research team, read an architecture diagram, and argue about what an agent should be trusted to do alone You have built a US-scale voice from outside the US, or know exactly why that is hard You are comfortable being visible: stage, podcast, analyst call, journalist on deadline The mindset that matters to us Builder. Build first, refine after Real curiosity the kind that makes you take things apart to understand how they work Hands on. Willing to get your hands dirty This is not the right role for you if you need an established category to market inside, if your track record is demand generation optimisation, if you brief agencies rather than write, if you need consensus before taking a position publicly, or if AI lives in your slides rather than in your daily workflow. Benefits Why Cleafy We protect hundreds of millions of digital banking users across Europe and Latin America, in a market that will consolidate around whoever moves fastest. Our board and investors back an aggressive category play. You join as a technically dominant company becomes a market-defining one, with the freedom to redesign how marketing works in the AI era. That window does not open twice. Compensation: Executive package (base, variable and equity), benchmarked against European scale-up leadership and calibrated to seniority and location. All employment decisions at Cleafy are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to ethnicity, color, religion or belief, gender, age, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Panoramica del ruolo Head of Sales | In sede (5 giorni a settimana) a Milano Siamo alla ricerca di un/a Head of Sales ambizioso/a e intraprendente per guidare, costruire e far scalare la nostra organizzazione commerciale di vendita in Italia, con sede presso i nostri uffici di Milano. L'Italia rappresenta uno dei mercati più vivaci e dinamici d'Europa per la cura della persona e il benessere. Cerchiamo un leader commerciale in grado di portare la nostra presenza regionale al livello successivo: gestendo le performance commerciali quotidiane, facendo crescere leader di vendita in prima linea, alzando gli standard dei team outbound e inbound e adattando il nostro playbook di vendita per prosperare nel mercato italiano. Con oltre 440 nuove assunzioni già effettuate quest'anno a livello globale, stiamo crescendo velocemente. Il team di vendita globale di Fresha ha recentemente raggiunto il 110% del target e tu giocherai un ruolo centrale nel guidare questo slancio in Italia. Si tratta di un ruolo pratico ("hands-on") per una persona che ama costruire, testare ed eseguire, con l'autonomia di introdurre strategie commerciali localizzate e stabilire sistemi scalabili. Cosa farai Leadership delle vendite commerciali: Gestire le performance commerciali end-to-end in tutta Italia, guidando le entrate, obiettivi ambiziosi di acquisizione di esercenti (merchant) e la responsabilità sulla pipeline. Sfruttare l'esperienza pratica sul campo per identificare le sfumature del mercato locale, ottimizzare i tassi di conversione e mantenere il team focalizzato sulla crescita. Costruzione e scaling del team: Costruire, selezionare e guidare un'organizzazione di vendita commerciale locale ad alte prestazioni, formando Team Leader di prima linea, attirando i migliori talenti commerciali e definendo percorsi di carriera chiari. Gestione delle performance e coaching: Promuovere una cultura orientata ai risultati e alle alte performance. Fissare KPI chiari, fare coaching a manager e Account Executive tramite review della pipeline, celebrare i successi e affrontare tempestivamente i cali di rendimento. Infrastruttura di vendita e cadenze operative: Implementare e perfezionare i flussi di vendita (sales motions), la reportistica CRM, le cadenze di contatto e i sistemi di instradamento dei lead necessari per scalare nei centri urbani italiani. Utilizzare analisi guidate dai dati per individuare precocemente le criticità. Eccellenza commerciale e allineamento GTM: Collaborare a stretto contatto con il General Manager e la leadership globale Revenue per adattare le strategie go-to-market per saloni indipendenti, spa e clienti enterprise italiani. Innovazione e IA per le vendite: Promuovere l'adozione di strumenti di intelligenza artificiale e automazioni per la prospezione, la visibilità della pipeline e la comunicazione, ottimizzando la produttività dei venditori e riducendo la durata del ciclo di vendita. Cosa stiamo cercando Leadership commerciale: Almeno 4–5 anni di esperienza diretta nella gestione delle vendite, con una comprovata esperienza nel superamento degli obiettivi di fatturato in ambienti commerciali ad alto volume e ad alta velocità. Esperienza di scaling: Esperienza comprovata nel reclutamento, nella gestione e nello scaling di team di vendita (idealmente oltre 30 persone tramite Team Leader o più livelli manageriali). Esperienza di settore: Solido background in vendite B2B SaaS, marketplace, fintech o abilitate dalla tecnologia ad alta velocità. L'esperienza nella guida di team di vendita telefonica interna (inside sales) o outbound/inbound ad alto volume è un valore aggiunto rilevante. Competenza del mercato e lingue: È richiesta una piena padronanza professionale sia dell'italiano che dell'inglese. Profonda comprensione del contesto commerciale italiano, delle abitudini di acquisto delle PMI e della cultura d'impresa locale. Padronanza di dati e sistemi: Approccio fortemente analitico, orientato ai processi e competenza nell'uso dei moderni strumenti CRM e di sales engagement (es. Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach) per gestire i ritmi operativi. Stile di leadership: Leader pratico, energico, capace di guidare con l'esempio, conquistare la fiducia e promuovere una cultura di vendita inclusiva, disciplinata e motivata. La tua opportunità in Fresha Guidare la crescita regionale: Assumere la piena responsabilità della nostra espansione commerciale in Italia, portando rapidamente il team dalle fasi iniziali fino a un importante hub operativo. Formare i leader del futuro: Fare da mentore diretto e promuovere i sales manager italiani, formando la prossima generazione di leadership commerciale internazionale di Fresha. Definire la strategia GTM: Stabilire come Fresha affronta l'acquisizione di esercenti, la localizzazione e l'onboarding dei partner nei principali centri metropolitani italiani. Visibilità globale: Collaborare a diretto contatto con la leadership esecutiva, i country manager interfunzionali e i responsabili commerciali globali per condividere insight regionali e scalare le best practice. Impatto concreto: Giocare un ruolo fondamentale nella digitalizzazione dell'ecosistema italiano del beauty e del wellness, contribuendo direttamente alla traiettoria di crescita del nostro unicorno a livello globale. Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo In Fresha stiamo creando una cultura in cui le persone di ogni estrazione si sentano valorizzate ed emancipate. Chiunque si candidi riceverà una valutazione equa e imparziale per l'impiego. Non discriminiamo sulla base di etnia, colore della pelle, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, età, stato civile, identità di genere, origine nazionale, disabilità o qualsiasi altra caratteristica legalmente protetta ai sensi delle normative sul lavoro italiane ed europee. Se hai esigenze specifiche di accessibilità o necessiti di adattamenti durante il processo di selezione o per l'ingresso in azienda, comunicacelo per permetterci di fornirti il dovuto supporto. Direct message the job poster from ThunderSoft Ziran Guo Ziran Guo Azienda: WiseGlow Sede di lavoro: Italia Settore: Energie Rinnovabili | Fotovoltaico | BESS | Soluzioni Digitali per l'Energia La posizione WiseGlow è alla ricerca di un/a Head of Business Development con una comprovata esperienza commerciale per guidare lo sviluppo delle nostre soluzioni di Smart Operations & Maintenance (O&M) nel mercato italiano. Cerchiamo un professionista con risultati di vendita concreti nel settore delle piattaforme di monitoraggio per impianti fotovoltaici, sistemi EMS/SCADA, soluzioni digitali per l'asset management o servizi O&M . Il ruolo offre un'elevata autonomia commerciale, la possibilità di sviluppare relazioni strategiche con i principali operatori del settore e un impatto diretto sulla crescita del business. Principali responsabilità Guidare lo sviluppo commerciale delle soluzioni Smart O&M di WiseGlow sul mercato italiano. Acquisire nuovi clienti tra produttori indipendenti di energia (IPP), proprietari di impianti fotovoltaici e BESS, investitori, asset manager e operatori O&M. Sviluppare partnership strategiche e consolidare relazioni con i principali decision-maker del settore. Gestire autonomamente l'intero ciclo di vendita, dalla generazione delle opportunità alla negoziazione e chiusura dei contratti. Collaborare con i team tecnici e operativi per proporre soluzioni integrate di monitoraggio, ottimizzazione delle performance e manutenzione. Costruire una pipeline commerciale solida e raggiungere obiettivi di fatturato misurabili. Profilo ricercato Comprovati risultati commerciali in almeno uno dei seguenti ambiti: Piattaforme di monitoraggio fotovoltaico/BESS e digital asset management. Sistemi EMS, SCADA, PPC o software per la gestione dell'energia. Servizi O&M per impianti fotovoltaici e contratti di manutenzione pluriennali. Portafoglio di contatti consolidato presso proprietari di impianti, IPP, investitori e operatori del settore energetico italiano. Esperienza dimostrabile nell'acquisizione autonoma di clienti e nella conclusione di contratti B2B di valore significativo. Ottime capacità di negoziazione, gestione di clienti strategici e sviluppo di nuove opportunità commerciali. Approccio imprenditoriale, orientamento ai risultati e capacità di operare con autonomia. Ottima conoscenza dell'italiano e buona padronanza professionale dell'inglese. Costituiscono un importante valore aggiunto: il superamento costante degli obiettivi di vendita, un portafoglio di clienti acquisiti direttamente e l'esperienza nella commercializzazione di soluzioni SaaS o servizi O&M con ricavi ricorrenti. Perché scegliere WiseGlow? Responsabilità sul mercato: un ruolo chiave nello sviluppo del business Smart O&M in Italia. Soluzioni innovative: l'opportunità di operare all'intersezione tra energie rinnovabili, tecnologie digitali e ottimizzazione delle performance degli impianti. Autonomia commerciale: spazio per definire strategie di acquisizione clienti, partnership e nuove opportunità di crescita. Prospettive di sviluppo: possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla crescita di un business in espansione nel settore delle energie rinnovabili. Cerchiamo chi sa trasformare le opportunità in risultati concreti. Se hai una comprovata esperienza di successo nella vendita di tecnologie per le energie rinnovabili o servizi O&M, saremo lieti di conoscerti. Chi è Fresha Fresha è il principale sistema operativo basato sull’intelligenza artificiale per il settore globale della beauty e del wellness , offrendo alle aziende tutto ciò di cui hanno bisogno per lavorare in modo più efficiente, crescere più velocemente e costruire relazioni più solide con i propri clienti. Nel maggio 2026, Fresha ha ottenuto un investimento per la crescita di 80 milioni di dollari da KKR, con una valutazione di 1 miliardo di dollari , raggiungendo ufficialmente lo status di unicorno e portando il totale dei finanziamenti raccolti a 285 milioni di dollari. Già redditizia, Fresha sta utilizzando questo investimento per accelerare la propria espansione globale e guidare la prossima generazione di innovazione nell’ambito dell’intelligenza artificiale e dei prodotti. Oggi Fresha opera su scala globale, con uffici in Europa, Nord America, Medio Oriente e Asia Pacifico. La nostra piattaforma è utilizzata da oltre 130.000 aziende del settore beauty e wellness in 120 Paesi , con più di 1,5 miliardi di appuntamenti prenotati fino ad oggi. La nostra missione è semplice: aiutare le aziende del settore beauty e wellness a crescere, offrendo loro la tecnologia di cui hanno bisogno per acquisire clienti, gestire le proprie attività e far funzionare il proprio business in un unico posto. Stiamo continuando a crescere rapidamente in nuovi mercati, team e prodotti, rendendo questo un momento entusiasmante per entrare a far parte di Fresha. Il ruolo Stiamo cercando un/una Business Development Manager ambizioso/a e orientato/a ai risultati per entrare a far parte del nostro team commerciale in Italia e contribuire direttamente alla crescita di Fresha sul mercato. Riportando direttamente al/alla General Manager, Europe , sarai responsabile dello sviluppo di nuovo business, dalla costruzione della pipeline fino alla chiusura delle opportunità commerciali e alla gestione delle relazioni con i partner. Avrai un ruolo chiave nell'identificare nuove opportunità, entrare in contatto con i principali decision-maker e dimostrare il valore di Fresha attraverso un approccio commerciale consulenziale. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con il team Commerciale e con le funzioni interne per contribuire alla crescita del business e garantire un'esperienza eccellente ai nostri partner. È un'opportunità ideale per una persona che ama lavorare in un ambiente veloce, dinamico e in continua evoluzione , che sa lavorare con autonomia, è motivata dalle sfide e vuole avere un impatto concreto sulla crescita di un'azienda globale. Retribuzione e potenziale di guadagno Il tuo potenziale di guadagno sarà direttamente legato ai risultati raggiunti, con l'opportunità di aumentare ulteriormente i tuoi guadagni attraverso il raggiungimento e il superamento degli obiettivi commerciali. Cosa farai Sviluppo di nuovo business: Sarai responsabile della crescita del nuovo business in Italia, costruendo e gestendo una solida pipeline e raggiungendo costantemente gli obiettivi di vendita. Prospecting & Outreach: Identificherai e coinvolgerai i principali decision-maker attraverso telefono, email, social e incontri di persona quando appropriato, creando nuove opportunità commerciali. Gestione del ciclo di vendita: Gestirai l'intero processo commerciale, dalla ricerca e qualificazione dei prospect fino alla demo, negoziazione e chiusura. Vendita a valore: Presenterai e venderai i prodotti e servizi Fresha attraverso demo efficaci e personalizzate, collegando le nostre soluzioni alle esigenze e agli obiettivi di business dei potenziali partner. Partnership strategiche: Condurrai analisi delle esigenze e dei benefici economici per comprendere il business dei prospect e identificare le soluzioni Fresha più adatte alle loro necessità. Gestione dei lead: Contatterai tempestivamente il 100% dei lead inbound qualificati, mantenendo il CRM aggiornato e assicurando una gestione accurata di tutte le opportunità. Gestione delle relazioni commerciali: Sarai un punto di riferimento per i partner durante le attività commerciali, costruendo relazioni solide e di lungo periodo. Collaborazione cross-functional: Lavorerai a stretto contatto con i team interni per garantire un'esperienza fluida ai partner e contribuire al raggiungimento degli obiettivi commerciali. Insight di mercato: Monitorerai trend e sviluppi del mercato italiano beauty e wellness, condividendo insight utili a migliorare la nostra strategia commerciale. Cosa cerchiamo Esperienza commerciale B2B: Esperienza comprovata nelle vendite B2B e un track record di risultati commerciali concreti e consistenti. Esperienza nel settore: L'esperienza in aziende SaaS, marketplace online o piattaforme di pagamento è fortemente apprezzata. Commercial Hunter: Sei una persona proattiva, orientata ai risultati e capace di creare nuove opportunità e costruire relazioni con decision-maker. Gestione della pipeline: Sai gestire una pipeline commerciale in modo strutturato, stabilire priorità e organizzare efficacemente il tuo tempo per massimizzare i risultati. Autonomia e ownership: Ti assumi la piena responsabilità dei tuoi risultati, lavori con autonomia e sai trasformare le opportunità in azioni concrete. Curiosità e crescita: Sei naturalmente curioso/a, hai una mentalità imprenditoriale e sei motivato/a a imparare, svilupparti e migliorare continuamente. Competenze linguistiche: Ottima conoscenza dell'italiano e dell'inglese, con la capacità di comunicare efficacemente con partner italiani e team internazionali. Beauty & Wellness: L'esperienza nel settore beauty, wellness o self-care rappresenta un forte plus. In Fresha, valorizziamo la passione e il potenziale tanto quanto le competenze e l'esperienza specifica . Se sei ambizioso/a, curioso/a e desideroso/a di imparare, ti incoraggiamo a candidarti anche se non possiedi tutti i requisiti indicati. Crediamo nel dare alle persone di talento l'opportunità, il supporto e l'autonomia necessari per eccellere nel proprio ruolo. La tua opportunità in Fresha Guadagna in base al tuo impatto: Una struttura OTE competitiva che premia performance e risultati commerciali. Fai crescere il mercato italiano: Avrai un ruolo diretto nello sviluppo del nuovo business e nell'espansione di Fresha in Italia. Cresci insieme al business: Entra a far parte di un'azienda globale in rapida crescita, con l'opportunità di ampliare rapidamente il tuo impatto e le tue responsabilità. Lavora a stretto contatto con la leadership: Avrai visibilità e collaborazione diretta con la leadership commerciale e internazionale di Fresha. Costruisci il futuro: Aiuterai sempre più aziende del settore beauty e wellness ad adottare la tecnologia Fresha e contribuirai a plasmare il futuro del settore. Inclusione e diversità In Fresha stiamo costruendo una cultura in cui persone provenienti da ogni background possano sentirsi a proprio agio, incluse e pienamente valorizzate. Tutte le candidature saranno valutate equamente. Non discriminiamo sulla base di razza, colore della pelle, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, età, stato civile, identità di genere, nazionalità, disabilità o qualsiasi altra caratteristica tutelata dalla legge applicabile nel luogo in cui la candidatura viene presentata. Se hai esigenze di accessibilità che potrebbero rendere più confortevole il processo di selezione o il tuo ingresso in Fresha, faccelo sapere: saremo felici di supportarti. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Description Travel Requirement: This role requires frequent national travel within Italy, approximately 50% of working time. You will spend significant time in the field visiting partner and carrier locations across the Italian network — observing the live customer returns experience, coaching partner teams on the spot, and gathering the insights that shape how network-wide improvements are rolled out. All travel expenses are reimbursed in accordance with Amazon's travel and reimbursement policy. Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) exists to make returns effortless and reliable for every Amazon customer — no matter which store or partner they walk into. In Italy, we deliver that experience across more than 17,000 partner and carrier locations, through convenience-led options such as Label-Free, Box-Free (LFBF) drop-off and every other way a customer can return an item in-store. The ISX Program Manager, Italy owns the quality and consistency of that experience across the whole Italian network. Because returns run through thousands of independent partner sites, the experience can vary widely from one location to the next and the core of this role is closing that gap. You will get into the field, see how returns actually happen at partner locations, coach partners and their teams to the standard customers expect, and use data to focus your time on the sites that need help most. Your mission is holistic: improving in-store returns execution across all return types, so a customer's experience is just as good at the busiest location as it is at the smallest. This is not only a field-execution role. It carries a strategic remit that reflects its level. Beyond coaching individual sites, you will help design and deploy the network-wide improvements that lift the entire Italian network at once: in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment mechanisms, associate support and training, and the tools partners rely on to process returns. You will translate what you learn in the field into scalable programs, work across internal teams to launch them in Italy, and help shape how the broader EU standards themselves are built, turning local, on-the-ground insight into lasting structural improvement. This is also a founding, build-from-scratch role. You'll be the first ISX Program Manager in Italy and one of the earliest members of the EU field team, reporting directly to the EU ISX Senior Manager. There's no established playbook yet, you'll help create it. We're looking for someone with real ambition, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to focus relentlessly on the initiatives that matter most while the team, tools, and standards are still taking shape. Key job responsibilities Own the in-store returns experience in Italy across ~17,000 partner and carrier locations, ensuring returns are fast, easy, and reliable for customers across all return types. Get into the field and coach. Visit partner locations, observe how returns are handled, and coach partner teams to Amazon's standards for speed, accuracy, and customer experience. Use data to prioritize. You can't be everywhere. Use performance data to identify the locations and partners falling furthest behind and concentrate your effort where it improves the customer experience most. Drive measurable improvement on the metrics that define a great returns experience: how fast customers are served, how reliably returns are processed, customer satisfaction, and site readiness. Deploy network-wide improvements. Lead the rollout of scalable programs that raise the standard across the entire Italian network, including in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment, associate support and training, and returns-processing tools , using your field insight to prioritize and adapt them for the market. Shape strategy from the field. Turn on-the-ground observations into recommendations that influence how EU-wide returns standards, mechanisms, and programs are designed, ensuring the field perspective is built in from the start. Manage performance to resolution. Follow a structured coaching and follow-up cycle for underperforming sites, and partner with the right internal teams (Business Partnerships for retail partners, the Transportation team for carriers) when issues need to be escalated to a partner's leadership. Build the foundation. As a founding team member, help shape how the EU field team audits, coaches, and reports, adapting proven practices from the North America team to the Italian market and feed your field insights into the monthly ISX reporting that informs strategy. A day in the life You start the week by reviewing performance data for Italy and identifying the partner locations and carriers falling furthest behind on the customer experience. You spend time in the field visiting a risk-weighted set of those sites, watching real customers complete returns, checking that the process is running smoothly, and coaching partner teams on the spot. Back at your desk, you're also driving the Italy rollout of a new signage standard and a store-supplies replenishment mechanism, using what you saw in the field to shape how they're deployed. You log your findings, build improvement plans for the sites that need them, escalate the bigger systemic issues to the right internal team, and close the week by capturing insights for the monthly ISX report and re-planning around wherever the customer experience needs you most. About The Team Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) owns the returns journey end-to-end for Amazon, everything that happens after a customer decides to send something back until delivery at our FC. Our purpose is simple but hard: make returns effortless and reliable for every customer, while running one of the largest, most complex reverse-logistics networks in retail. Within RLS, the In-Store Experience (ISX) team focuses on where returns meet the real world, the thousands of partner and carrier locations customers walk into to drop off an item. We turn a single promise into a consistent reality across every one of them: fast, easy, dependable returns, no matter which door a customer chooses. Working from the field, we close the gap between the best and worst locations, coach partners to a standard customers can count on, and build the mechanisms that lift the whole network at once. Our culture is hands-on, data-driven, and high-ownership. We obsess over the customer, thrive in ambiguity, dive deep into the details on the ground, and think big about how to scale what works — because the best decisions about in-store returns are made by people who've seen them happen firsthand. We are looking for someone eager to leverage AI potential for innovation—someone who loves experimenting with AI tools and actively sharing that knowledge across the sourcing team. Reporting directly to the Head of Commercial Strategy, you will take full ownership of shaping, defining, and executing innovative initiatives to improve the sourcing journey — driving solutions across all retail sectors, European Sales Analysts, and Key Account Managers by Q4 2027. Your core focus will be delivering measurable business value: driving efficiency across the Sourcing journey by streamlining data preparation, designing scalable target processes, and empowering our commercial teams to focus on high-value analysis and negotiation. 🎯 TASKS 1. Project Vision, Governance & Delivery Develop the strategic vision for the project by synthesizing commercial team feedback and organizational goals, driving innovation through the integration of advanced AI capabilities. Serve as the Project Lead within our delivery framework, taking ownership of business requirements, proof-of-concept validation, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Maintain a clear, consolidated project roadmap with defined milestones, owners, and timelines. Facilitate effective project governance with core working teams and executive sponsors. Build and manage a Key User Community to gather structured feedback, validate user testing against defined quality thresholds, and prioritize the backlog. 2. Business Requirements & Cross-Functional Alignment Drive alignment across key business stakeholders, including Sales Analysts, Key Account Managers, Sales Production, Logistics, Finance, and Data Science. Draft clear, comprehensive, and detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) encompassing functional scope, business rules, acceptance criteria, and edge cases. Build robust business cases for new program modules, clearly defining user impact, operational options, cost structures, and anticipated ROI, creating POCs with AI to validate & improve the business case. 3. Process Design, Optimization & Value Tracking Map and optimize the end-to-end Sourcing journey across its core steps. Own and maintain the business value model—tracking weighted time savings per sale across tasks, user profiles, and business units. Focus on true process redesign: identifying opportunities to eliminate or automate redundant tasks rather than simply accelerating existing manual steps. Publish regular performance dashboards tracking adoption rates, realized value against plan, and module quality standards. 4. Change Management, Rollout & Adoption Design and execute tailored rollout and change management strategies (communications, training materials, and sequencing) across European sectors and countries. Define and formalize the ongoing operational support model and SLA structure prior to go-live. Monitor user adoption post-launch, actively identifying and closing gaps between feature eligibility and actual usage. Ensure comprehensive documentation of all processes and activation criteria to ensure long-term operational excellence. 👉 MUST HAVE skills Experience: Minimum 5 years of professional experience in a commercial, sourcing, operations, or management consulting environment, with demonstrated expertise in project management and process design. Experience delivering internal-facing tech/data products is highly valued. Project & Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of managing complex cross-departmental projects through structured planning and collaborative leadership. AI Proficiency & Innovation: Stay up-to-date with AI developments, leverage AI to its full potential, and actively apply AI capabilities to drive transformation and project success. Business Analysis & Requirements: Strong capability in writing detailed, actionable business requirements for technical development teams. Commercial Skills Data & Business Literacy: Proficient in building, defending, and tracking business value models and performance metrics. Tech Familiarity: Comfortable working with tech & data products, understanding their practical business applications and performance constraints. Change Management: Excellent communication and influence skills, with experience managing change and animating key user communities. Languages: Business fluency in English is required; international work experience is a plus. Certifications: Lean/Six Sigma or Agile certifications are a bonus. ✅ BENEFITS 👉Opening hours flexible & flexibility about holidays and permits 👉Ticket Restaurant 👉Dynamic and creative environment within international teams 👉Variety of self-education courses on our e-learning platform 👉Team buildings & afterworks 👉Hybrid work model with the possibility to smartworking 2 days a week 👉 Variable Bonus 👉Free afternoon on your birthday ❓ TEAM, WHO WE ARE ? You will join the Sourcing Excellence team—a dedicated, collaborative group focused on shaping the methodologies, tools, and processes supporting over 400 local sourcing professionals across Europe. Our Team Values: Grow Together: We succeed as a team, supporting each other's professional growth. Transparency: Open communication and freedom of expression are encouraged. Empathy & Humility: We stay grounded and customer-focused in helping our sourcing teams. Continuous Improvement: We step out of our comfort zones, welcome constructive feedback, and embrace continuous learning. Excellence: We bring structure and rigor to everything we build. ⚙️RECRUITMENT PROCESS 1️⃣ Interview with HR Manager 2️⃣ Interview with Head of Methodology & Strategy 3️⃣ Interview with Head of Sourcing Excellence 4️⃣ Optional: Interview with 1 or 2 future colleagues within the Methodology & Strategy Team All our positions are open to people with health conditions or impairments. We are convinced that it is up to you to define the way you work, to develop yourself and to progress. At Veepee we guarantee that you can just be yourself! For the service of diversity and inclusion, Veepee is committed to reviewing all applications received on an equal basis. Segnala offerta di lavoro Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you. We’re looking for a Senior Account Manager - Groceries to join our Milan (Italy) team. In this role, you’ll act as a strategic consultant for our restaurant partners, using data-driven insights and industry knowledge to lead their growth on our platform. Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. What You’ll Be Doing You’ll be joining the Grocery team. This position is based in Milano. We oversee relationships with high-volume strategic partners, using data-driven insights to navigate the rapidly evolving quick-commerce landscape. Here’s What Your Day-to-day Might Look Like Strategic Partnership Management: Act as the primary consultant for a portfolio of different small and medium retail partners, building deep, long-term relationships. Growth Consulting: Use data manipulation and analysis to identify trends, increasing profitability and growth for both your partners and Deliveroo. Revenue Generation: Drive commercial value through upselling, cross-selling, and identifying new business opportunities within your portfolio. Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with Marketing, Operations, and Customer Service to develop and implement bespoke solutions that solve partner challenges. Operational Excellence: Serve as the main point of contact for strategic partners, addressing complex issues with professional, timely, and scalable solutions. Essential What You’ll Need to Thrive Significant commercial experience, with a background in groceries, FMCG, or high-growth technology companies. Knowledge of the food retail industry, understanding the unique challenges and opportunities within the grocery sector. Proven ability to manage long-term relationships with strategic stakeholders and global brands. Professional fluency in Italian and good command of English to collaborate with our global teams and partners. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, You’ll Do Work That Matters, Solving Real-world Problems In a Three-sided Marketplace That’s Constantly Evolving. We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here You Can Expect To 🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders. 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility. 🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves. 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here. PlayMore! ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da PlayMore!. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 40.000,00 €/yr - 75.000,00 €/anno Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da PlayMore! Enrico Petracco Enrico Petracco PlayMore! is a fast-growing non-profit organization that promotes Sport, Participation and Wellbeing, for All , since 2010. We are looking for an experienced leader to drive the growth and international expansion of our flagship project, RunChallenge. About RunChallenge RunChallenge is an international community that promotes participation and wellbeing through sport, particularly running and walking, bringing together people with and without disabilities, including wheelchair users. Every week, more than 1,100 people with and without disabilities take part in training sessions and social activities organized across 14 European cities . Over the years, RunChallenge has received several awards. Among the most significant: Finalist (Top 3) at the European Commission #BeInclusive EU Sport Awards 2021 ; Charity of the Year at the Milan Marathon 2025 ; Top Fundraiser Non-Profit Organization at the Milan Marathon Awards 2026 ; Best Cheering Point at the Milan Marathon Awards in 2024, 2025 and 2026 . In 2026, SDA Bocconi School of Management published a research study to RunChallenge entitled Scaling Social Inclusion through Sport: The RunChallenge Case , validating the project's development model and highlighting its potential for growth and expansion. We firmly believe this potential is still significant because RunChallenge addresses two of the greatest challenges of our time: tackling loneliness and physical inactivity . Our dream is to transform RunChallenge into the Scout Movement of Sport : a global movement capable of spreading a culture of participation through thousands of local communities united by the same values. If our vision resonates with you and you're excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of RunChallenge, we'd love to hear from you. The Role The Head of RunChallenge will be responsible for leading the evolution of the project, working closely with the CEO of PlayMore! and coordinating the project team, which currently includes: 1 Senior Project Manager 1 Event Manager 1 Junior Project Manager 1 Head Coach 1 Educational Coordinator 8 Sport trainers and Educators Key Responsibilities Following an onboarding period designed to provide a deep understanding of PlayMore!'s culture, the RunChallenge model and the activities already in place, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following areas: Vision and Strategy Define RunChallenge's three-year development strategy in Italy and abroad Strengthen the existing RunChallenge Social Franchising model Define objectives, priorities, KPIs and monitoring tools Lead the three-year operational plan, ensuring alignment between strategic vision and day-to-day execution Network Development Manage and expand the international RunChallenge network, overseeing the team member responsible for partner relations and network expansion Design and implement new strategies to identify and engage potential partners interested in bringing RunChallenge to their local communities Identify new development opportunities, partnerships and ways to scale the project Team Leadership Lead the RunChallenge team, enhancing the skills, responsibilities and motivation of all team members Work collaboratively with the leaders of the organization's other strategic areas: Communication, Fundraising, Administration, Volunteers, Events and Activities Promote a team culture based on trust, accountability, constructive feedback and continuous improvement Ensure quality, consistency and continuity throughout the experience of participants, volunteers, donors and project partners Events, Community and Representation Design and oversee the delivery of all RunChallenge events, including both sporting events and initiatives aimed at strengthening the network (such as the Milano Relay Marathon, the RunChallenge Gathering at Anteo Cinema, the RC> International Meeting, etc.) Represent RunChallenge at public events, institutional occasions and networking opportunities Manage relationships with the project's stakeholders (public institutions, corporate partners, private donors, direct and indirect beneficiaries) Design and coordinate initiatives that strengthen the sense of belonging within the RunChallenge community, beyond sporting activities Project Quality In day-to-day operations, ensure quality, consistency and attention to detail across every aspect of the RunChallenge experience: sporting activities, social gatherings, sporting and community events, and both external and internal communication. What we are looking for Native English speaker or fluent English (C2) 10+ years of experience in managing and developing complex projects, ideally in an international context Experience leading teams and managing relationships with diverse stakeholders Ability to combine strategic vision with strong operational execution Strong results orientation and commitment to measuring impact Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills Confidence in public speaking What set you apart Experience in developing scalable models, social franchising, territorial networks or international-scale projects Professional and/or personal experience abroad or in multicultural environments Knowledge of a second foreign language Passion for sport as a tool for social transformation Mindset & Attitude We are looking for someone who brings: Sporting Spirit: a willingness to get personally involved and actively participate in RunChallenge and other PlayMore! projects Purpose: genuine enthusiasm and a deep belief that our actions can change the world for the better, starting with making sport and social participation accessible to everyone Leadership: the ability to inspire, listen, empower people and build trust What We Offer A key leadership role within a growing organization Direct responsibility for a European project with global ambitions A direct connection between your work and the social impact it generates Flexible working hours, autonomy and trust A young, dynamic and stimulating work environment An organizational culture built on excellence, teamwork, mutual respect and meaningful relationships Spoken Languages Italian: native speaker or equivalent proficiency English: native speaker or fluent (C2) Contract and Salary Sports employment contract. Salary will be defined to gether, taking into account your experience, expectations and personal circumstances. A probationary period will apply. Location and Working Arrangements PlayMore! headquarter: Milan (Moscova district). Flexibility and autonomy in managing working hours and office presence: objectives and operational needs will guide the balance between office-based and remote work. Availability to travel within Italy and internationally for monitoring visits and exchanges with partner organizations across the network is required. Availability Full-time. How to Apply Please send the following to jobs@playmore.it : Your CV in Italian and English, or in English only, clearly highlighting the required competencies A personal cover letter (maximum 5 lines) in both Italian and English We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. RICERCA KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT – LOMBARDIA Bergamo Gas e Luce , realtà operante nel mercato dell'energia e in costante crescita, ricerca un/una KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT per la Lombardia , a cui affidare lo sviluppo e il coordinamento delle attività commerciali sul territorio regionale. La risorsa avrà un ruolo strategico nel percorso di crescita dell'azienda, con la responsabilità di sviluppare nuove opportunità di business, acquisire direttamente nuovi clienti e costruire, coordinare e far crescere una rete commerciale efficace e strutturata. PRINCIPALI RESPONSABILITÀ Sviluppare il mercato di riferimento attraverso l'acquisizione di nuovi clienti e nuove opportunità commerciali. Gestire direttamente trattative e relazioni con clienti strategici. Ricercare, selezionare e sviluppare una rete di agenti e collaboratori commerciali. Coordinare, motivare e supportare la rete vendita, monitorandone i risultati e favorendone la crescita. Definire e implementare strategie commerciali per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi assegnati. Consolidare le relazioni con clienti, partner e realtà del territorio. Monitorare l'andamento del mercato e individuare nuove opportunità di sviluppo. Garantire il presidio commerciale e lo sviluppo del business nelle diverse province lombarde. REQUISITI Esperienza consolidata in ambito commerciale, preferibilmente nel settore energia e utilities. Esperienza nella gestione e nel coordinamento di reti vendita. Spiccate capacità di negoziazione, relazione e sviluppo del business. Orientamento agli obiettivi e capacità di lavorare in autonomia. Attitudine imprenditoriale, dinamismo e capacità di leadership. Ottime capacità organizzative e di gestione delle relazioni. COSA OFFRIAMO Auto aziendale ad uso lavorativo. Telefono e PC aziendali . Trattamento economico composto da una parte fissa e una componente variabile legata al raggiungimento degli obiettivi. Pacchetto retributivo commisurato all'esperienza e al profilo professionale. Rimborso delle spese sostenute per l'attività lavorativa. Ampia autonomia operativa e gestionale nell'organizzazione dell'attività. Supporto aziendale, strumenti e risorse per lo sviluppo commerciale. Concrete opportunità di crescita professionale all'interno di una realtà in espansione. LA SFIDA Cerchiamo una persona con spirito imprenditoriale, capace di sviluppare il proprio territorio, costruire relazioni commerciali solide e guidare una rete vendita verso obiettivi ambiziosi. Una figura che sappia unire capacità di vendita, visione commerciale e leadership, contribuendo attivamente alla crescita di Bergamo Gas e Luce. Segnala offerta di lavoro About Us Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of. What You'll Be Doing As our Data Analyst, you'll be a key member of our Growth & Marketing (G&M) team, putting data and intelligence first to drive real business impact, from user acquisition and engagement to retention and monetisation. Here's what that looks like in practice: Drive Decision-Making Through Data - Analyse complex datasets to identify patterns impacting the consumer funnel (Acquisition, Engagement, Retention, Monetisation). Partner with Marketing Managers and other stakeholders to deliver in-depth analysis across the full product lifecycle to maximise ROI. Partner with Key Stakeholders - Act as a strategic partner for Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Product, bridging the gap between technical data and business goals and translating complex analysis into clear, executive-level recommendations. Build High-Impact Visualisation Tools - Define key metrics and develop dashboards and reports that communicate analytical insights effectively, empowering stakeholder self-sufficiency. Contribute to Data-Mesh - Actively work on the development of the federated data layer by designing robust data models and building pipelines that integrate into the company's data strategy, ensuring scalable and governed data ownership. Promote Agentic Analytics - Contribute to the enrichment and adoption of AI-powered agentic workflows for data transformation and exploration, accelerating analytical capabilities and enabling self-service for key stakeholders. Drive Testing Initiatives - Own the end-to-end testing pipeline, from opportunity identification to experiment design and recommendation delivery, operating effectively in a fast-paced environment. Who We're Looking For This role needs someone who is a problem-solver with a strong analytical mindset, who is detail-oriented, and ready to take ownership in a dynamic, collaborative environment. Relevant Experience - 4 years in data-related roles spanning across Business Intelligence, Business Analytics, or Analytics Engineering, with hands-on experience in high-volume, or big data environments. Data Modelling & Data Mesh Expertise - Hands-on experience in data modelling, ETLs and data transformation layers. Real world exposure to Data Mesh and contributive data ecosystems is a plus. Technical Proficiency - Strong command of SQL and Git. Experience with dbt and notebook-based analytics (e.g. HEX, Databricks, Jupyter) is a plus. Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills - Comfortable with ambiguity, able to break down complex problems into unit workstreams and deliver evidence-based answers. Position: Customer Service Manager Brand: Alumo (Ultra-Premium Shirting Fabrics) Location: Italy Reporting & Team: Reports to Commercial Director | Direct Team: 2 Representatives | CONTEXT AND CHALLENGE Chargeurs PCC is the world’s leading provider of textiles and inner component solutions: from luxury fashion to athleisure and everything in between. Interlinings are the soul of any garment, giving structure, shape, and added performance to every piece. With over 350 million meters of interlinings produced annually across 10 production sites, Chargeurs PCC supports 7,000 customers around the world, from iconic fashion houses to technical apparel leaders. Now expanding beyond interlinings, Chargeurs PCC has launched its first outer fabric collection, setting new standards in performance, design, and responsible innovation. Chargeurs PCC is a division of Belgrano (formerly Compagnie Chargeurs Invest), listed on the EXN Paris, with a successful industrial history of over 150 years. We are seeking an energetic, resilient, and forward-thinking Customer Service Manager to lead our front-office operations in Italy for Alumo, the historic Swiss brand globally recognized as the pinnacle of luxury cotton shirting fabrics. The entity is currently undergoing an extensive restructuring program aimed at modernizing workflows, increasing operational agility, and harmonizing customer-facing activities. The primary mission will be twofold: to ensure impeccable day-to-day service continuity for our global clientele while spearheading the total redesign and optimization of operational processes. The role requires navigating legacy systems for an initial transition period of a few months while actively championing and preparing the organization for the implementation of a modern, future-proof ERP system. | RESPONSIBILITIES Process Redesign & Optimization: Re-engineer end-to-end customer care and order management workflows. Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs), eliminate operational bottlenecks, define service KPIs, and build a lean, scalable order fulfillment experience matching luxury standards. ERP Modernization & Change Management: Serve as the key operational champion for the upcoming ERP rollout. Lead requirement definition, workflow testing, data integrity, and team onboarding, while ensuring flawless execution on the legacy ERP during the initial interim months. Team Leadership & Organization: Manage, coach, and organize the daily work of a 2-person customer service team. Allocate accounts, structure workloads, foster high autonomy, and cultivate a collaborative culture rooted in transparency, mutual support, and operational rigor. Operational Customer Care: Oversee the complete lifecycle of customer orders—from initial inquiry, custom swatch requests, and price quotations to order entry, production tracking, shipping coordination, and billing. Step in directly to manage complex or VIP client inquiries. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the vital liaison between customer service, sales leadership, warehouse logistics, and planning to guarantee frictionless communication, rapid issue resolution, and accurate delivery timelines. | PROFILE REQUIREMENTS Experience: Solid background (minimum 4–6 years) in customer service or sales operations, including at least 2–3 years in a managerial or team-lead role. Prior background in luxury B2B sectors, high-end menswear, bespoke tailoring, premium textiles, or complex manufacturing environments is strongly preferred. Process & Systems Savvy: Demonstrated track record of process redesign, workflow structuring, or participating directly in ERP migration/modernization projects. Comfort and pragmatism in navigating legacy systems while preparing new digital solutions. Languages: Full professional fluency in both English and Italian (written and spoken) is strictly required. A good working knowledge or fluency in French is considered a distinct competitive advantage. Resilience & Velocity: Thrives in evolving environments undergoing structural change; capable of delivering swift, high-quality solutions under pressure. Organization & Autonomy: Super organized with rigorous attention to detail, proactive self-starter mindset, and the ability to take full ownership of operational challenges. Leadership & Transparency: True team player with empathetic yet clear communication, fostering an open and transparent dialogue across all internal and external touchpoints. | WHY JOIN US? Join an Undisputed Luxury Leader: The opportunity to play a transformative operational role within one of the most prestigious and historic names in the global luxury textile industry. Competitive Compensation: Attractive compensation package comprising a structured base salary and a rewarding incentive plan tied to organizational milestones and operational performance. Company Equipment & Tools: Complete suite of professional IT tools and resources (laptop, smartphone, ergonomic office setup). Executive Exposure: Direct visibility and collaboration with executive management, offering substantial influence over the entity's organizational evolution. Buona comprensione delle integrazioni tra SAP MM e gli altri moduli, in particolare WM, SD e FI/CO. Esperienza nella raccolta dei requisiti, nell’analisi funzionale e nella gestione di change request e sviluppi evolutivi. Conoscenze di base di ABAP, utili all’analisi delle personalizzazioni e al confronto con il team di sviluppo. Esperienza in contesti aziendali caratterizzati da processi articolati e sistemi SAP fortemente integrati. Livello retribuzione di base 40.000,00 €/yr - 60.000,00 €/anno La Divisione DE&I di LHH RS è alla ricerca, per conto di un’importante realtà internazionale operante nel settore farmaceutico , di un/una Product Manager appartenente alle Categorie Protette (Art.1 L.68/99) da inserire all'interno del team Marketing. La risorsa contribuirà allo sviluppo e all'implementazione delle strategie di marketing relative ai prodotti assegnati, collaborando con i principali stakeholder interni ed esterni e supportando le attività di lancio, promozione e sviluppo del business. L'azienda valuta con interesse sia profili con esperienza consolidata nel marketing farmaceutico sia candidati più junior interessati a consolidare un percorso professionale nell'ambito del Product Management. Responsibilities Supportare la definizione e l'implementazione delle strategie di marketing per i prodotti assegnati , in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali locali e globali. Gestire le attività di marketing lungo tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto , incluse attività promozionali, educational, campagne marketing e supporto ai lanci di nuovi prodotti. Analizzare mercato , trend di settore, attività dei competitor e performance dei prodotti al fine di individuare opportunità di sviluppo e supportare le decisioni strategiche. Collaborare con i team Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Market Access, Sales e Commercial Excellence per garantire l'allineamento e l'efficacia delle iniziative di business. Sviluppare materiali promozionali e formativi nel rispetto delle normative vigenti e delle procedure aziendali. Supportare la forza vendita attraverso strumenti, contenuti e attività formative dedicate. Collaborare nella gestione delle relazioni con Key Opinion Leader, professionisti sanitari, società scientifiche e altri stakeholder di riferimento. Partecipare ad attività sul territorio per raccogliere insight di mercato e cogliere le esigenze dei professionisti sanitari. Supportare la pianificazione e l'organizzazione di congressi, eventi scientifici e iniziative rivolte alla comunità medico-scientifica. Collaborare con team internazionali per l'adattamento al mercato locale di strategie, campagne e materiali marketing. Coordinare fornitori e agenzie esterne, garantendo il rispetto delle tempistiche, degli obiettivi e degli standard qualitativi. Supportare le attività di budgeting , forecasting e monitoraggio delle performance. Contribuire allo sviluppo di iniziative di marketing digitale e omnicanale volte a migliorare l'engagement dei professionisti sanitari. Partecipare alla gestione e all'aggiornamento dei canali di comunicazione digitali aziendali, inclusi sito web , portali dedicati e social network. Monitorare KPI e dati di mercato per valutare l'efficacia delle iniziative implementate e identificare opportunità di miglioramento. Your Profile Requisiti: Appartenenza alle Categorie Protette (Art.1 L.68/99). Laurea in discipline scientifiche (quali Farmacia, CTF, Biologia, Biotecnologie, Medicina) o percorsi affini. Esperienza pregressa in ambito Product Management, Brand Management o Marketing Farmaceutico. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese , scritta e parlata. Dimestichezza con strumenti digitali e del pacchetto Office. Spiccate capacità organizzative e di gestione delle priorità. Ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative Approccio proattivo, orientamento al risultato e capacità di lavorare in team. Costituiscono un plus: Esperienza nella gestione di lanci di prodotto e attività di customer engagement. Familiarità con iniziative di marketing digitale e omnicanale. Master o formazione specialistica in Marketing Farmaceutico, Marketing o Business Administration.
